name: Aesthetics in Design
description: On successfully completing this course, a student should be able to discuss and define aesthetics in design from a broader perspective of form, function and ergonomics. A student will also discuss the beauty and its manifestation in various domains, including science, engineering, technology, and design. A student will be able to understand the psychological foundations of aesthetics through elements and principles of visual design. The course will introduce them to a generic visual design process they can apply in various design specializations.
